chunks: So We evacuated everyone who was a believer there,
ai.seo_question: Who did God evacuate from the place mentioned in Surah Ad-Dhariyat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Adh-Dhariyat is often linked to the deliverance of the faithful from the torments of Hell or the specific afflictions of their time, emphasizing God's active role in salvation. It underscores the theme of divine mercy intervening to rescue believers from the consequences of their trials, distinguishing them from the disbelievers who remain in their state. This extraction is seen as a manifestation of God's promise to protect the righteous from ultimate ruin.
